body.name: \mathsf H_{\mathrm{prof}}
body.construction: At every \(c\in\mathcal G_c\) and \(\vartheta\in\mathcal G_\vartheta\), profile certified support-wide one-sided H\"older margins subject to \(\mu_{Y,P}^{+}(c)-\mu_{Y,P}^{-}(c)=\vartheta\{\mu_{D,P}^{+}(c)-\mu_{D,P}^{-}(c)\}\), while leaving each bin's association coordinate free over its binary Fr\'echet interval. Calibrate the complete four-cell count vector with \(\Delta_n(c,\vartheta)\) and \(\Gamma_n(\delta_n)\); use the grid and sieve schedule in \(\text{def:profile-resolution-schedule}\); invert the tests; enlarge by \(\eta_{\vartheta,n}\); and take the connected hull. Track \(\zeta_n\), \(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{cont},n}\), the displayed global false-split bound, \(2\delta_n\), and the probability of every fallback separately. Use the exhaustive fallback list in \(\text{def:worked-four-cell-grid}\), returning \(\Theta\) on every listed branch. Finite-grid validity is uniform over all compatible binary treatment--outcome associations because calibration uses multinomial type probabilities rather than an invertible joint-score covariance.
